### Problem

Autopilot pull requests stall without anyone being told, for days, and one that touches the engine's core blocks every issue queued behind it.

### Scope

The fix trigger in pull-request.yml and org-pull-request.yml (a failed required check, a review that ends without a verdict), autopilot.yml's fix mode reading the failed jobs' log, waiting.py's board for that state, their tests, and docs/workflows.md.

### Out of scope

Why a given check failed. The review's own crash in #723 (#720).

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given an autopilot pull request whose scripts job fails, when its checks complete, then a fix round starts with the failed jobs' log, without a person.
C2: Given an autopilot pull request whose review ends without a verdict, when its checks complete, then a fix round starts the same way.
C3: Given an autopilot pull request whose rounds reached `autopilot-rounds`, when a check fails again, then no round starts and it is handed to a person with `needs-human`.
C4: Given either state, when the board is written, then it names the fix round that is running, or the person, never a fix nothing will start.
C5: Given a repository of the organisation other than DiluxOne/.github, when the same happens there (org-pull-request.yml), then C1 to C4 hold too.

### Criticality

Critical
